health.flat 350.0, magicResistance.flat 45.0, abilityHaste.flat 15.0 — and magicPenetration/magicResistance shred entries are all 0.0, i.e. current Unmake is a pure damage-taken amplifier, not a magic-resist reduction.

{{tip|Immobilize|Immobilizing}} an enemy champion marks them as ''Vulnerable'' for 4 seconds, increasing the damage they take from all sources by 7%. — quoted only to confirm it is a distinct, separately-sourced 7% all-damage amp and is NOT part of the 'Abyssal Mask — Unmake' leaf.

m(R) = 100 / (100 + R) ... post = raw · m(R). No Abyssal/Unmake-specific formula appears anywhere in the document; the amplifier is therefore an independent multiplicative factor on the damage packet, not a resistance-side term.

independent_computation.rule_extracted: Unmake (unique passive, no stacking, no ranks, no level or stat scaling in the cached text): an enemy champion within 700 units of the Abyssal Mask holder is cursed and receives 12% increased magic damage from ALL sources — explicitly including damage dealt by the holder's allies, which is what a 'support_damage_multiplier' on an allied carry's event encodes.
steps: 1. Read the only numeric in the cached effect text: 12% increased magic damage (700 is the curse radius, a flat range, not a damage term).
2. Convert 'X% increased damage taken' to a multiplicative damage factor: multiplier = 1 + X/100.

4. Cross-check against a second independent representation of the same item: riotDescription says 'take 12% more magic damage' → 1.12. Third representation, data/atoms/items.json atom damage.magic for Abyssal Mask, carries values [700.0, 12.0] with units [flat, percent] → 12 percent → 1.12. All three agree.

5. Confirm the factor is a damage-side amplifier and not a resistance shred: items['8020'].stats.magicPenetration and the passive's stats block are all 0.0, so the effect cannot be modelled through m(R) = 100/(100+R); it multiplies the packet. Applying it as a separate 1.12 factor is the correct shape.

6. Confirm the leaf is single-source: Imperial Mandate's Vulnerable is a distinct 7% all-damage-type amp with its own trigger (immobilize) and 4 s window; it is correctly NOT folded into a leaf tagged 'Abyssal Mask — Unmake'. Had both been merged into this one leaf the value would have had to be 1.12 × 1.07 = 1.1984 (or 1.19 additively), which it is not — consistent with per-source attribution.

7. Old value <absent> means no ally-curse amplification was applied to this event at all. The cached wiki text says the curse applies to magic damage 'from all sources', so a magic-damage event on a cursed target with the Abyssal holder in range must carry the amplifier. Absent is therefore an understatement of the true damage by exactly the 12% factor.

residual_uncertainty: The scenario definition (roster composition, event ordering, and the damage type of events[3]) lives outside the permitted read scope (tests/scripts), so this receipt verifies the MAGNITUDE and SOURCE of the multiplier, not the gating. If events[3] were a physical or true damage packet, or if the Abyssal holder were beyond 700 units at that timestamp, the correct value would be <absent> rather than 1.12 — nothing in data/ can settle that.

Conditional on events[3] being a magic-damage packet on a cursed target (which the scenario name 'mandate_abyssal_curse_roster' and the leaf's own source tag both assert), 1.12 is exactly right and is the only value the cached patch-16.15 text supports.
